channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 36th Annual Alabama Veterans Affairs Association Conference (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Sunday 10/18 | Orange Beach Convention Center | No published price. The Orange Beach Convention Center hosts the 36th Annual Alabama Veterans Affairs Association Conference from Sunday, October 18, through Thursday, October 22. The statewide conference brings training and professional development programming to Alabama Veterans Affairs Association members.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Weekends 10/16-11/1/2026 · eves + matinees | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost-comedy plays at Fairhope's intimate community playhouse, a witty, dressed-up date in Fairhope.

item.title: Blue Angels + Dolphin Cruise (watch practice from the water) (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesday 10/20 · departs 9:35 AM, flight ~10:30 AM | Frisky Mermaid, departs behind Shaggy's | from $55. Watch the Blues practice from the bay with dolphins alongside, the double-header of a space-obsessed kid's dreams. It runs on NAS practice mornings and sells out days ahead.

item.title: Blue Angels Practice (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesday 10/20 · gates 9:30 AM, practice ~10:30 AM | National Naval Aviation Museum flight line | Free. The Blue Angels fly a Tuesday practice over the National Naval Aviation Museum's flight line at NAS Pensacola. The flight-line gates open at 9:30 AM, the jets are scheduled up at about 10:30 AM, and watching costs nothing. The museum is free afterward, with more than 150 restored aircraft inside. There is no autograph session on this date, but the Wednesday 10/28 practice has one. Base entry pauses once the museum lot is full, so plan to arrive early.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Oct 17 to Oct 30 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions from October through April. The first sessions in this window run Saturday 10/17 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/18 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Saturday 10/24 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/25 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Friday 10/30 at 9:30 PM. Capacity is limited for each session, so buy tickets early.

item.title: Pumpkin Decorating Contest at Niceville Library (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Entries through Saturday 10/17 · voting Monday 10/19 to Saturday 10/24 · winners Tuesday 10/27 | Niceville Library | No published price. Niceville Library runs a pumpkin decorating contest for ages 13 and older. Entrants drop off a decorated pumpkin with a completed entry form during library hours through Saturday, October 17, and visitors vote for a favorite from October 19 to 24. The top three pumpkins win prizes announced on October 27, and entrants collect their pumpkins by 2:00 PM on October 31.

item.title: Sonic Live in Concert at the Saenger Theatre (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesday 10/20 · 7:30 PM (doors 6:30 PM) | Saenger Theatre, Mobile | No published price. A live ensemble with a rock band, electronics and vocalists performs music from the Sonic the Hedgehog games alongside iconic moments from the games, as part of a 35th anniversary celebration. The show is at the Saenger Theatre in downtown Mobile.

item.title: Teen Dungeons and Dragons at Moorer (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Saturdays 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM · Tuesdays 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library runs a tabletop Dungeons & Dragons adventure for teens ages 12 to 18. Registration is recommended, and upcoming sessions include Tuesday, October 6, Saturday, October 17, and Tuesday, October 20.

item.title: The 39 Steps: Hitchcock Farce (ECTC) (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Oct 15-25 · Thu-Sat 7 PM · Sun 2 PM · Wed 1 PM · Thu 10/22 also 1 PM | Emerald Coast Theatre Company | No published price. Four actors play 150 roles in a full-tilt Hitchcock spoof that is clean, fast, and laugh-out-loud. It is the safe-bet theatre date of the fall.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (TUE 10/20)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (TUE 10/20)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (TUE 10/20)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Stretch & Flow Yoga (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. This Vinyasa-style yoga class blends longer intentional holds with gentle flow to build flexibility and release tension. It meets for an hour first thing in the morning at the Niceville Senior Center. The center requests a $3 donation for the class, on top of its usual access rates.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (TUE 10/20)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.

item.title: Party Bridge (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This game at the Niceville Senior Center is built for seasoned players rather than beginners. Players call the Senior Center's bridge organizer to reserve a seat, so spots are not first come, first served. It runs Tuesday mornings into early afternoon.

item.title: Chair Yoga (TUE 10/20)
item.description: 9:45 AM to 10:45 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. This Chair Yoga class at the Niceville Senior Center mixes seated poses with supported standing work. It aims at posture, flexibility, core strength, joint mobility, balance, stability and stress reduction. It asks a $3 donation and repeats every Tuesday and Thursday morning, for members age 55 and up.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Good Listener's Storytime at Parkway (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM | Parkway Branch Library | No published price. Parkway Branch Library runs a storytime built for listening, with stories, rhyming games, and crafts, aimed at children ages 3 to 7. The library asks that groups register ahead of time, though individual families are not required to. It repeats on Tuesdays, including October 6 and October 13.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free.

item.title: Next Generation Homeschool Art: Ages 7-9, Tuesday Mornings (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Pensacola Museum of Art: Classroom | from $180. Next Generation Homeschool Art is a visual arts course for ages 7 to 9 that follows National Visual Arts Standards. Group A meets Tuesday mornings from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at the Pensacola Museum of Art, taught by Marce Wagner, known as Ms. Messy. Term 1 runs August 25 through October 13 and costs $160 for museum members or $180 for non-members. Three other weekday groups are available for different ages and schedules.

item.title: Read & Play Storytime (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library: Youth Programming Room | No published price. Ben May Main Library's Read & Play Storytime combines books, songs, and fingerplays for babies and toddlers alongside a caregiver. The library says it is best suited for ages 0 to 3 and is built to support sensory, listening, and memory development. It repeats every Tuesday, including October 6 and October 13.

item.title: Story Time: Pumpkins at the Valparaiso Library (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Monday 10/19, Wednesday 10/21 and Friday 10/23 · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM | Valparaiso Library | No published price. Valparaiso Library devotes its Monday, Wednesday and Friday morning story times to pumpkins for the week of October 19. Monday is for ages 0 to 5, Wednesday welcomes all ages and Friday is for ages 0 to 3. Registration is required for each session.

item.title: Words with Friends (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Despite the name, this Niceville Senior Center program is a writing and sharing group, not a session of the mobile word game. Participants work from simple prompts and writing exercises, then read their stories aloud, and the city says no writing experience is required. It meets Tuesday mornings.

item.title: Children: Lap Babies Storytime (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM | Daphne Public Library | No published price. Daphne Public Library hosts a storytime for lap babies, Tuesday from 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM. Tuesday sessions in October fall on the 6th, 13th, 20th and 27th at this same time.

item.title: Family/STEAM Story Time at Big Lagoon State Park (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays 10/20 through 10/27 · 10:30 AM | Big Lagoon State Park | No published price. Family STEAM Story Time at Big Lagoon State Park is a library storytime with songs, movement and a STEAM activity, held in the park on Gulf Beach Highway in Pensacola. It's for ages 2 to 5 with caregivers. It meets Tuesday, October 20 and Tuesday, October 27 at 10:30 AM.

item.title: Midday Melodies: Downtown Foley (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 · 11:00 AM | Heritage Park | No published price. Foley Main Street schedules a lunchtime concert at Heritage Park on Wednesdays in October, starting October 7 at 11:00 AM. The 2026 lineup is the Wiley Pete Duo on October 7, Dan Lee on October 14, This Side of 49 on October 21, and Tennessee Tim and Doug Drake on October 28. The 2025 series invited guests to bring a picnic blanket or lawn chair and pick up lunch from a nearby downtown restaurant.

item.title: Preschool Storytime at Jay Library (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 11 AM-11:30 AM, through 12/1 | Jay Library | No published price. Preschool Storytime is a weekly storytime for preschoolers at Jay Library, 5259 Booker Ln., part of the Santa Rosa County Library System. It runs 11-11:30 AM on Tuesdays from Oct 6 through Dec 1.

item.title: Seated Zumba Gold (TUE 10/20)
item.description: 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. Seated Zumba Gold is a chair-based dance-fitness class for members who use a wheelchair or live with limited mobility or balance concerns, set to lively music. It asks a $3 donation every Tuesday and Thursday late morning. The class is part of the Niceville Senior Center's programming for members age 55 and up.

item.title: STEAM: Midnight Kitty Painting (Pensacola Library) (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 to Saturday 10/31 · 11:00 AM | Pensacola Library | No published price. STEAM: Midnight Kitty Painting is a step-by-step painting class at Pensacola Library, 239 N. Spring St., where you paint a little shadow kitty watching the moon. It is recommended for ages 10 and up. A themed painting class is held almost every Saturday through Oct 31 at 11 AM.

item.title: Tuesday Time Out Storytime (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesdays · 11:00 AM to 11:30 AM | Grand Bay Library | No published price. Grand Bay Library runs a preschool oriented storytime for children ages 0 through 5. Tuesday sessions run at 11 AM through October, including October 6 and October 13.

item.title: Veterans & First Responders Appreciation Lunch (TUE 10/20)
item.description: Tuesday 10/20 · 11:00 AM | Niceville Community Center | No published price. A Superior Mechanical hosts a lunch at the Niceville Community Center honoring veterans, active-duty military and first responders, and this is the second year the company has put it on. It starts at 11 AM on a Tuesday.
